cell_rationale.user_prompt_active: F01 clause derivation runs at intake (UserPromptSubmit).
cell_rationale.posttool_active: F01/F02 evidence classification runs at PostToolUse.
cell_rationale.session_end: SessionEnd command budget (3s host contract) must not regress.
cell_rationale.memory_stop: Stop allocation guard (tracemalloc peak_bytes) for the shared derivation path.

budget_rationale: A cell is DECLARED-SLOWER only when the 99% bootstrap lower bound of the candidate/baseline ratio exceeds 1.10 AND the absolute lower-bound delta exceeds 50 ms (2 MB for peak_bytes). Tail-only regressions are declared through the p95 statistic; inconclusive pairs are retained as INCONCLUSIVE and never read as passes; failed samples are retained without replacement.
rule: No sample count is increased after seeing results. A failed attempt blocks acceptance and is never replaced.

retention_worker.reason: The published 0.16.1 baseline has no retention maintenance API; an A/B ratio is undefined for the new worker. The worker is measured as its own budgeted run, never folded into Hook cells.
retention_worker.scenario: run_retention_attempt: fixed twelve-session backlog (six eligible, six protected) built by the measured runtime, one policy-gated apply pass, exact count oracle
retention_worker.rule: Any failed attempt blocks acceptance. Budgets registered before measurement; never widened after seeing results.
